_doc: score51_v54.json of the public release: the pvscore 5.4 driver configuration of the two evaluation packages (media tasks; script tasks) merged into one. Only the dataset entry (one dataset, vibeprevisbench, for every task, its briefs at paths.DATASET_TASKS), the version label and the members_509 set fingerprint (the union of the two packages' per-task members, files unchanged) differ from the packages; rules, weights, thresholds, selection and layers are theirs.

protocol.policy_doc: keys given here replace aggregate.POLICY (P1-P9 defaults: worker_lost recover, max_rerun_batches 2, content_filter_retries 1, watchdog infra, watchdog_h_new_batches 8); empty = the approved defaults. score51.py --policy KEY=VALUE overrides per run and is recorded in the output.

selection.delivered: protocol cell final.status = delivered: the attempt final.out is scored (the launcher's own status is not consulted, P2)
selection.score_recovered: protocol pending action score_recovered (worker lost after the scene check, files present): scored like a delivered attempt when its selfcheck directory holds dump.json; otherwise pending needs_acquire
selection.model_fail: protocol final.status = model_fail: 5.1 total 0 and 5.0.12 total 0
selection.no_dump: a delivered / recovered attempt without dump.json is pending needs_acquire (pvscore5 acquire run on the attempt's scene.blend, an E2B sandbox; never 0)
selection.other_pending: every other protocol pending action (rerun, wait, rescore, infra_exhausted) stays pending with the protocol's action; not scored
selection.task_check: sha256 of paths.TASKS/<item>/task.json must equal the cell's task_sha256 (the item the model was given); otherwise pending task_mismatch, not scored
selection.claims: text profile claims_v5: paths.v5_claims(item) must exist with gt_item = the item (else pending no_claims) and its prereg_sha256 must equal the sha256 of paths.V5_PREREG (else pending claims_prereg_mismatch)

unknown_dataset: a cell whose dataset is not listed is pending unknown_dataset (no GT pack for it)

layout_r2.what: the r2 text / image layer (tools/v51_text_r2: 3D L1 / L2 / S / R1 facts + view blocks), as for spatial_arkit / spatial_keyframe items

claims_v5.what: the text lead's v5 claims (claims_score.py: blocks layout / entity / camera on the model dump) with the SCORING_v5 s2 slot table; the cell's layer is v5 and the layout_r2 text layer is not run for it

reference_column: pvscore 5.0.12 total recomputed by score51.py from the same dump with pvscore5.score.score_item (vendored copy in the package); the batch's own report.json total is recorded beside it and a difference is flagged

totals.quality_on_delivered: mean 5.1 total over the scored delivered attempts
totals.overall: mean 5.1 total over resolved items (scored delivered + model_fail as 0); pending items are left out and the totals are marked provisional while any is pending
totals.common: the same means over the items every non-baseline model of the dataset has resolved
totals.reference: the same three means of the 5.0.12 total

gates: combine_weights_v51r3.json gates (as r2) + r3_rules.gates_r3 (same members / N/A dims for every pair of models); ceilings and temporal_in_total are documentary

layers.view: continuation / video items: model_view.run + view_score.score_model on data/v51_r2/<item>/checklist.json + scene_frames.json (entries with scorable_new in view_score.SKIP left out)
layers.text: script / spatial_arkit / spatial_keyframe items with data/v51_text_r2/<item>/gt_facts.json: model_side.run + score.run_jobs (chance_3d.perms permutations)
layers.none: an item without new-layer GT (no checklist; no gt_facts.json, or a gt_facts.json whose fact counts are all 0, e.g. M50_031 / 032 without GT boxes) is scored on its kept 5.0.x blocks only, recorded as layer null with the reason
layers.temporal: temporal_score.py is not part of the 5.1 total (tb = {}, as the r1 default: the r1 'temporal' column was a variant); its blocks stay a diagnostic; r3 (B5): still not part of the total
layers.v5: script items under claims_v5: claims_score.from_dump + score_scene + a1_counts_drop on the dump (paths.V5_CODE), written to --out/v5/<item>/<model>.json; combined with combine.profile_weights(r2 weights, text_profile_claims_v5.json)

exhausted: cells with protocol action infra_exhausted are left out of every model's counts and of the common items, as the protocol does
text_profile_override: score51.py --text-profile NAME: every script cell of the run uses that profile instead of its dataset's; recorded as text_profile_override in scores.json / summary.json. Used for smoke and gate runs of claims_v5 on miniset50_v1 dumps (v1 prompts state coordinates: such numbers are not v5 results)
datasets_doc: registered with their own task files (paths.DATASET_TASKS; the package copies them to gt_pack/datasets/<name>/ with the dataset's manifest.json): miniset50_v3 (text profile claims_v5). Every dataset is scored on the same GT (gt_pack); a dataset's cells are the batch cases whose directory is <name>/<item> (delivery protocol: dataset = the case dir's parent name)

members_509.doc: paths.MEMBERS_ROOT/<dir>: <item>.json + index.json from tools/v51_r2/members_509.py build (GT only); the driver refuses a set whose sha256 or pvscore version differs
